root_cause: Table.add_row auto-creates missing columns with Column(_index=index). Column.highlight defaults to False, so an implicitly created column ignores Table(highlight=True) and its cells render without repr highlighting (regression since 13.8.1).
best_solution: In Table.add_row, where the loop hits index == len(columns) and builds a new Column, pass the table's setting through: Column(_index=index, highlight=self.highlight). The statement says it outright: columns added by add_row should default Column.highlight to Table.highlight. Grep add_row, find the single Column(...) constructor call, and inherit the parent's flag there. Columns made by add_column already take highlight from the table, so this is the only path that was missing.
hidden_test_demands:
tests/test_table.py::test_columns_highlight_added_by_add_row: Table(show_header=False, highlight=True).add_row('1', repr('FOO')); asserts table.columns[0].highlight == table.columns[1].highlight == table.highlight, and the recorded console export_text(styles=True) equals exactly '┌───┬───────┐
│ \x1b[1;36m1\x1b[0m │ \x1b[32m'FOO'\x1b[0m │
└───┴───────┘
' (number highlighted bold cyan, string green).
locating_signals: The title names the function ('add_row') and the attribute ('highlight'). The body names Column.highlight, its default of False, and Table.highlight as the value to inherit. One grep for 'def add_row' in rich/table.py plus reading ~30 lines reaches the only Column(...) call in it. The gold function is named explicitly.
our_outcome_summary: v4, v6 and v7 PASSED with patches byte-identical to gold (Column(_index=index, highlight=self.highlight)), in 41-55 s and 12-29 calls. v8 FAILED with an empty patch after 17 s and 14 tool calls. It was not a wrong fix: the v8 locator stage read all of rich/table.py in several chunks and then read all of tests/test_table.py (369 lines of box-drawing expected output, very token-dense). The prompt reached 28,673 tokens, which plus 4,096 reserved output tokens is past the 32,768 context limit, so litellm raised ContextWindowExceededError (retried 5 times) and the sandbox aborted before any edit. v8 also wasted early calls on a malformed run_skill_script call (missing skill_name) and on an investigate.py call that errored.
generalizable_lesson: Do not read whole test files that hold rendered or snapshot output (tables, box-drawing, ANSI): they are token-dense and can overflow a 32k context on their own. Grep for the one test or function you need and read a bounded line range. Also check the context budget before each read and edit early. Once the statement names the function and attribute and a single constructor call is found, make the edit before exploring further. On the fix itself: when a container auto-creates child objects (columns, rows, nodes) and the child has a default-False option that mirrors a parent option, the child should inherit the parent's value at the implicit-creation site.
acceptable_alternatives: Any change that makes add_row-created columns take highlight from the table would pass, for example setting column.highlight = self.highlight after construction. Changing Column's default to True would be wrong, because add_column(highlight=False) must stay unhighlighted.
